Technology stocks were higher in recent trading, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 gaining almost 0.3% as the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index rallied 1.1%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) NXP Semiconductors NV ( NXPI ) added 2% during Monday trading after the chipmaker was selected to become a component company of the Nasdaq-100 Index, effective with the start of trading Nov. 5.
In other sector news:
(+) Yandex ( YNDX ) rose almost 6% at one point during Monday trading after the Russian language search engine company reported better-than-expected Q3 earnings and revenue and raised its FY18 revenue outlook above Street views.
(-) Tower Semiconductor ( TSEM ) dropped as much as 18% on Monday after the semiconductor foundry company reported below-consensus Q3 financial results and upstaging an upbeat Q4 revenue forecast.
